digest.component_or_area: binding store recovery and retirement lifecycle
propositions: After a crash with retired tombstone present but live replacement incomplete, the exact overlap (identical tombstone, forward, and reverse identities) is undetectable at construction/preview time but safely completable at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary after under-lock staleness check and before first remote fetch

Retirement completion is a no-op on repeat; any tombstone/forward/reverse identity mismatch, corrupt live entry, or replace failure aborts safely without unrelated mutation and preserves recoverable evidence

Explicit unretire removes the durable tombstone and prevents completion; later automatic confirmations (200 response, clear_absent, same-key bind_confirm) do not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity

Production code no longer mutates binding entries obtained through all_bindings(); rich-text emission uses the narrow facade operation and carries no false claim about binding_store.py accessor capability
